checkpoint.purpose: SKU condition alignment, Claude part of the 2026-10-10 split. Selected arm: japanese-reranker-small-v2 with exact-first, mutual best match over all Rakuten axes and explicit symmetric/one-sided axis split (align-...-reverse-all-v4axes: axes.jsonl, decisions, diff vs rule gate v10, handoff.jsonl for the Codex description check, score-axes). Also: questions, raw answers and align summaries/scores of the compared arms (Qwen3.5 2B/4B-int8, ModernBERT-Ja-310m-jev, Ruri v3 Reranker, exact-string only), the manual axis reference for the 29 pairs, and the earlier Qwen3.5 relation probes. conditions.jsonl is omitted (about 300 MB); regenerate with align_sku_conditions.py align.
checkpoint.extract_at: repository root; preserve .lab-output relative paths; use unzip -n
checkpoint.label_derived_content: score-*.json hold aggregate counts against the Luna v3 machine labels of the 29 confirmed pairs and against Claude's manual axis reference (reference/axis-correspondence-legacy.json, made after rule-gate and label scores were seen). No raw labels; family has no labels. The method was revised after reading these scores (label-informed development).
